flows.label: 1. Desktop local Agent run
flows.summary: A Thread tab starts a run; the shared store prepares prompt state, streams over typed Electrobun messages into the local runtime, core drives pi-agent/model APIs, and reduced events plus approved tool results return to the same per-tab store.

steps.action: ThreadTabPane injects the runtime-scoped RPC transport and callbacks.

steps.action: The Zustand store validates, snapshots prompt variables, resolves the model, and calls streamThread.
createRpcTransport assigns streamId and converts response messages into an async iterator.

evidence.note: Provides correlation, buffering, abort, and cleanup.

steps.action: RPC resolves the selected RuntimeClient; LocalRuntimeClient delegates to StreamThreadController.
StreamThreadController resolves provider connection; streamAgent drives pi-agent-core and emits AgentEvent values.

evidence.note: Calls the provider and yields events.

flows.label: 2. Thread persistence & run history
flows.summary: Renderer edits are serialized to workspace Thread JSON; successful runs are externalized as immutable snapshots under history/, referenced from the small Thread file, and re-keyed with file moves while deleted history is retained for trash recovery.

steps.action: A successful run creates usage/history/evaluation metadata and requests snapshot archival.

evidence.note: Builds and archives the newest run snapshot.

steps.action: ThreadTabPane queues changes in SerializedPersistence and flushes after 500 ms or run settlement.
fsWrite/fsArchiveRun/fsReadRunSnapshot dispatch to the Thread's runtime.
LocalRuntimeClient delegates filesystem and history operations to LocalFileSystem.
LocalFileSystem atomically writes Thread JSON; RunHistoryStore stores/rekeys/prunes external snapshots and ages orphans for 30 days.

flows.label: 3. Remote runtime over SSH/HTTP
flows.summary: The desktop establishes/trusts an SSH-hosted or manually configured runtime, registers it as RuntimeClient, sends ordinary RPC and Agent streams over bearer-authenticated HTTP/SSE, and presents the returned events through the unchanged shared UI flow.

steps.action: RemoteServerManager checks SSH host identity, bootstraps/connects, and RemoteRuntimeClient verifies protocol, version, and capabilities.
The connected client is registered and selected as the default runtime.
Renderer stream and filesystem/model calls continue through the same runtime-scoped RPC contract.

evidence.note: No UI-specific remote branch is required.

steps.action: The bearer-authenticated server maps /rpc and /stream to its headless LocalRuntimeClient and cancels on disconnect.
The remote host runs the same StreamThreadController/core streamAgent path against its own models, tools, files and network.
Remote SSE values become desktop RPC events and reduce into the same per-tab Thread store.

flows.summary: The build-flagged guest workbench restores a browser Thread, uses the shared store with a same-origin SSE transport, the guest API validates and charges quota before running an allowlisted BigModel request, then constrained tools and streamed results update browser state.

SQLite records only HMAC-hashed daily usage; localStorage retains user-visible Thread/library state.

BigModel streams the completion; safe server-side web/MCP tools are called only through guarded guest endpoints.
SSE events reduce into messages; workspace and first-success/evaluation state are written back to browser storage.
